summary: The three prior accounting mechanisms are corrected in the inspected source: additions and retirements account per object, and rename plus size events share one state insertion. No further duplicate accounting or ordering defect was identified in those paths. One replacement-path traceability defect remains. Store references mean Sources/DiskStewardCore/EvidenceStore/EvidenceStore.swift within the frozen snapshot.

findings.claim: Replacing a noncanonical hard-link binding records the wrong incoming path_before. Baseline old O has links /A and /B with canonical path /A; replace only /B with new N while /A survives. readPriorFileAtPath(/B) correctly finds O but returns its canonical row at /A. The incoming replacement therefore records path_before=/A and path_after=/B, although /A was not replaced or moved. The existing noncanonical replacement test checks totals and current state but not these path fields.
findings.recommendation: Preserve the replaced binding path separately from the old object's canonical metadata when inserting incoming replacement evidence. Extend the existing canonical/noncanonical, both-object-orders regression to assert incoming path_before and path_after both equal the actual replaced path, while preserving the surviving original binding.
